title: BATWA v2.4.48 Real-time Receiver Notifications & Credit Tracking
message: Real-time in-app receiver alerts, dynamic incoming credit amounts (+PKR), and enhanced financial statistics and activity tracking.
features: Real-time In-App Notifications: Automatic heads-up alert banner with haptic feedback on incoming transfers.
Accurate Credit & Debit Classification: Incoming transfers display in vibrant green with '+' sign across history and analytics.
Notifications Activity Feed: Bell screen lists all received and sent payments with direct receipt view.
Enhanced Inflow/Outflow Statistics: Real-time calculation of income vs expenses.
changelog: Fixed receiver transaction categorization: incoming transfers properly identified as credit (+PKR).
Added real-time transaction listener and instant heads-up notification banner for money received.
Revamped notification center with direct transaction receipt navigation.
Optimized backend transaction querying by wallet tag and phone number.
